issue_text: proveKind.Info() (prove.go:66-70) sets no NeedsJudge, so it defaults false, yet the prove executor DOES call an LLM judge in-process: symptomVeto (prove.go:359-382) invokes call(ctx, e.symptom, ...) on every Proven reproduction/deletion, and call->callAs (kind.go:434-436) sets req.Model,req.Effort = in.Node.Model, in.Node.Effort — the prove NODE's own model/effort. Production wires Symptom: j (the run's judge) in cli/wiring.go:275, and the shipped workflow gives the prove node `model: $JUDGE, effort: $JUDGE_EFFORT` with the comment 'model/effort feed the reviewer's judge call' (workflows/sdlc-loop-proved.yaml:24). Because the machine gates Preflight on NeedsJudge (machine.go:101 at Init, machine.go:634 before Advance), the prove node's model/effort are NEVER validated by judge.Preflight (cli/wiring.go:294). A prove node configured with a bad model id or an unsupported effort therefore passes Init and Advance, and only aborts at runtime IF a reproduction/deletion happens to prove (surfaced via isReviewerConfigError, prove.go:374). A pins-only or all-survived prove run never surfaces the misconfiguration at all — the same misconfigured workflow passes some runs and aborts others depending on whether a reproduction proves.

checkBugs (kind.go:214-232) validates b.Verdict against the `verdicts` set (kind.go:197), which accepts FIVE values: matched, real_but_ungold, hallucination, unverified_no_evidence, checked_but_unverified. But the rejection message (kind.go:224) reads 'verdict %q is not matched|real_but_ungold|hallucination' — listing only THREE of the five accepted verdicts. The two executor-minted verdicts (VerdictUnverifiedNoEvidence, VerdictCheckedButUnverified) that the adjudicate executor legitimately emits (kind.go:555, 568) and that a cmd delta may carry are accepted by the code but omitted from the user-facing 'valid options' text, so the message under-reports the valid set.
